function.arguments: {"finding": "The `channel` variable is not randomly assigned — the email campaign was deliberately targeted at loyal customers, who are more likely to convert regardless of channel. Therefore, comparing conversion rates directly by channel is confounded by `customer_segment`. The raw difference will not be the effect of the campaign.", "implication": "I must stratify by `customer_segment` before computing the difference in conversion rates. The correct approach is to compute the conversion rate difference within each segment and then combine them (e.g., via weighted average)."}
function.name: note_finding
